name: Saltwall Rising
description: Long-running serialized crime drama set in the Gray Zone's most contested transit corridors, following a rotating ensemble of enforcers, runners, and debt collectors navigating the brutal arithmetic of survival. Each episode is a full neural immersion — viewers live one shift from a single character's perspective, with no score, no narration, no safety filters. The show was praised for its refusal to glamorize augmentation disparity and condemned by three corponations for depicting their security contractors as antagonists.
cultural_impact: Introduced the phrase 'running saltwall' into Meridian slang, meaning to survive on pure nerve with no backup.
story_hooks: A player character receives a bootleg cartridge of Season 3 that contains a hidden data payload — someone used the feed to smuggle evidence of a real crime.
The show's lead neural-capture actor, Davorin Achebe-Ström's estranged daughter, has gone missing just as Season 6 production begins.
A Tier 3 journalist wants to profile the show's anonymous production collective — but the collective suspects she's a corpo plant.
